name: Sample: Verification commands
description: A small example pack showing every field. Import it from Practice > Question packs > Import file.
author: CCNA Academy

questions.stem: Which command lists each VLAN and the access ports assigned to it?
questions.explanation: 'show vlan brief' lists VLAN IDs, names, status and access ports. Trunk ports are listed by 'show interfaces trunk'.
whyWrong: This shows trunk ports and their VLAN lists.
This shows learned MAC addresses per port.
This shows interface IP addresses and status.

questions.stem: Arrange a bottom-up check of a host that cannot reach a remote server.
items: Check the link light and interface status
Check the VLAN and switch port
Ping the remote server by IP
Resolve the server name with DNS
questions.explanation: Troubleshoot from Layer 1 upward so each test relies on layers already confirmed to work.
questions.whyCorrect: Physical → data link → local IP → remote IP → application.

questions.stem: Match each command to the information it shows.
right: Neighbor IP addresses and software versions
Root bridge, port roles and states for VLAN 10
questions.explanation: Each command is the first stop for its feature: CDP neighbors, EtherChannel bundles, and per-VLAN spanning tree.
